name: Suzu Maruo
source:
Executive.

Takes pride in managing the operations at Kukuri Pharmaceuticals. Pledged loyalty to Kiyomasa and the company during Kiyomasa's lifetime and only cares about the company's future and his own position. Though he has no right to inherit, he believes the inheritance should benefit the company. He looks down on Yoichi and others as spoiled brats, fearing they might take over the company.

[From in-game suspect profile]
